translations.web: You may say in your heart, “How shall we know the word which Yahweh has not spoken?”
translations.bsb: You may ask in your heart, “How can we recognize a message that the LORD has not spoken?”
translations.kjv: And if thou say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the LORD hath not spoken?
translations.asv: And if thou say in thy heart, How shall we know the word which Jehovah hath not spoken?
